Extinction coefficient data provenance
======================================

The file haemoglobin-extinction.csv is mechanically derived from:

  MNE-Python mne/data/extinction_coef.mat
  commit b1fb8933a2ba62028b1dac3ae8bc24da0220d00e
  SHA-256 6b7fe0d64af92e542741b1a05e9c4a02233d088329e6e9f6ef9c5896f8871843
  https://github.com/mne-tools/mne-python

MNE-Python identifies the underlying values as Scott Prahl's compilation of
the Gratzer and Kollias haemoglobin spectra published by the Oregon Medical
Laser Center:

  https://omlc.org/spectra/hemoglobin/summary.html
  Copyright 1999 Scott Prahl
